tips: Approach steaming shallow pools to refill water before dehydration sets in.
Volcanic ash storms cut visibility—build a basic shelter early.
Stay clear of red meteor impact rings; fresh impacts often leave Primordial Crystals.
Body temperature spikes near lava rivers. Equip a Heat Shield when crossing rifts.
Toxic volcanic gas gathers near active craters—watch your oxygen gauge closely.
Place Fast-Travel Beacons in distant biomes to jump across the 4 km primordial map.

onboarding.slide1Body: No plants, no animals, no other humans exist yet. Only bare basalt plains, steaming shallow oceans, sulfur vents, obsidian fields, meteor showers, and active volcanoes across a 4 km world.
onboarding.slide2Body: Desktop: WASD move, Mouse orbit camera, Space jump, Shift sprint, E interact, I inventory, B build, M map, J journal, F3 debug. Mobile: multi-touch joystick & action buttons in portrait or landscape.
onboarding.slide3Body: Track Health, Stamina, Body Temp, Oxygen, Hydration, Radiation, and Fatigue. Progress through 5 Tech Tiers from stone tools to Archean synthesis and the Seed of Life.
onboarding.slide4Body: PRIMORDIA detected your hardware and selected a balanced graphics preset for smooth 3D playback. Adaptive quality will protect your framerate automatically.

info.title: Game Info
info.subtitle: Story, mechanics, missions, guide, terms and privacy of PRIMORDIA.

blocks.title: What is PRIMORDIA?
blocks.body: A 3D survival game in the browser, set on primordial Earth (Hadean–Archean). You are the first survivor on a {worldKm} × {worldKm} km world: no plants, animals or other people, only basalt, volcanoes and steaming oceans.

blocks.title: What is the story?
blocks.body: Your goal is not to conquer but to prepare life. You gather stone and minerals, smelt iron, mine metal from fallen stars, then brew prebiotic compounds until you can craft a Seed of Life. The last mission takes you to the Geyser Basin to plant it.

blocks.title: Main features
items: Open world with {biomes} biomes, streamed in chunks
{items} items and {recipes} recipes across {tiers} tech tiers
Modular building, chests, furnaces, Moss Gardens and Auto Drills
A {quests}-mission campaign in {chapters} chapters, {journal} journal entries, {achievements} achievements
Adam & Eve era: immortal age, a real-time sky, resources that regrow daily
Guest mode, cloud saves, leaderboard, friends and messages

blocks.title: Version {version}
blocks.body: Active era: {era}. The game grows in stages: survival foundation, mobile and cloud, then the Adam & Eve era. Planned next: full 3D assets (caves, ancient animals) and wider multiplayer.

blocks.title: Made by
blocks.body: © 2026 Jurkon Studio. All rights reserved. PRIMORDIA, its name, logo, mascot Bruk, game design and original code belong to Jurkon Studio.

blocks.title: World
blocks.body: A {worldKm} × {worldKm} km world streamed in {chunk} m chunks, with {biomes} biomes from shallow oceans to crystal craters.

blocks.title: Survival
items: Manage health, stamina, temperature, hydration and oxygen
Hazards: toxic gas, ash storms, acid rain, lightning and meteors
Gas Filters and shelters protect you; an on-screen arrow points to the nearest clean air
Difficulty scales pressure: Explorer ×{multExplorer}, Survivor ×{multSurvivor}, Hadean ×{multHadean}

blocks.title: A gentle start
items: The first {safeMin} minutes are safe: no storms and clean air within {safeRadius} m of the start
Until minute {easeMin}, survival pressure is reduced by {easePct}%
A Gas Filter equips itself when oxygen drops below {autoFilterPct}% and you own one

blocks.title: Items and crafting
blocks.body: {items} items across {tiers} tiers ({tierCounts} per tier) and {recipes} recipes. Recipes unlock as you find new materials. Base carry capacity is {carry}.

blocks.title: Adam & Eve era
items: Immortal age: no death from old age. Dying to hazards does not reduce your age
The sky follows your device clock; seasons: {seasons}
Base terrain is fixed; resources regrow daily (UTC). A Terrain Anchor shields a {anchorR} m radius from era changes
Wisdom from age ({wisdom}) unlocks perks: {perks}

blocks.title: While you are away
items: Up to {offlineMaxH} hours are simulated; under {offlineMinMin} minutes are ignored
A Moss Garden ripens in about {gardenHours} hours; an Auto Drill adds {drillPerH} stone per hour (max {drillCap})
Storms can damage buildings without a roof, but buildings are never destroyed completely

blocks.title: Death and saving
blocks.body: When you die, your items become a glowing bag where you fell (max 3 bags). The game autosaves every {autosaveSec} seconds and has {saveSlots} save slots.

missions.intro: A {quests}-mission campaign in {chapters} chapters. A blue arrow on screen points to the active objective. After the ending, continue in free survival or New Game+.

5.title: Chapter 5: Seed of Life
5.desc: Prebiotic chemistry, then the most important moment of this world.

blocks.title: Mission tips
items: Open the Journal [J] for repeatable survey contracts
Location missions show a destination arrow at the top center of the screen
Save before exploring far from a shelter

guide.heading: How to play
guide.controlsDesktop: Keyboard and mouse (rebind in the Controls tab)
guide.controlsMobile: On phones: left joystick to move, drag the screen to look, and RUN, BUILD, ACTION and JUMP buttons at the bottom right.

blocks.title: Start here
items: Fill water at the shallow pool (the blue arrow shows the way)
Collect stone and minerals, then craft a stone axe and shelter
Follow the active mission in the top-left panel

blocks.title: HUD modes
blocks.body: Tap the eye icon at the top right (or press H) to switch: Full, Compact or Clean. Your choice is remembered.

blocks.title: Common problems
items: Slow: turn off Particles and lower graphics in Settings
Breathless: equip a Gas Filter or follow the arrow to clean air
Lost items after dying: find the yellow light pillar and press [E]

blocks.title: 1. Acceptance
blocks.body: By playing PRIMORDIA you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, stop using the game.

blocks.title: 2. The service
blocks.body: PRIMORDIA is an entertainment game by Jurkon Studio and is still in development. Features may change, be added or be removed without notice.

blocks.title: 3. Accounts
blocks.body: You can play as a guest. An account is only needed for cloud saves, the leaderboard, friends and messages. Keep your account secure; you are responsible for its activity.

blocks.title: 4. Prohibited conduct
items: Cheating or tampering with saves, device clocks, scores or servers
Using bots or scripts to submit scores or messages
Sending messages that harass, threaten, scam or break the law
Copying, decompiling or reselling the game and its assets without permission

blocks.title: 5. Enforcement
blocks.body: Violations may lead to removed scores, limited social features or a ban from online services.

blocks.title: 6. Game data
blocks.body: Progress is stored on your device and, if signed in, in the cloud. Data can be lost through browser clean-ups, outages or version changes. Back up what matters.

blocks.title: 7. No warranty
blocks.body: The game is provided "as is". To the extent the law allows, {owner} is not liable for indirect damages, including lost progress.

blocks.title: 8. Changes and law
blocks.body: These terms may be updated; the date is shown below. They are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia.

blocks.title: In short
blocks.body: Guests: all data stays on your device. Signed-in players: game data is stored on a server so you can continue elsewhere. We do not sell your data and this game shows no ads.

blocks.title: Account data
items: Account ID, email from the sign-in provider, display name (max 16 characters) and avatar settings
Used to sign you in and show your profile

blocks.title: Game data
items: Save slots (player and world state, seed, play time) and game settings
Character birth time, death count and last active time, for immortal age and away-time calculation
Score for the leaderboard

blocks.title: Social and online data
items: Friend list and message text (max 500 characters) with read status
With online mode on: your name, appearance and position are shared temporarily with other players in the same world. Inventory and saves are not sent

blocks.title: On-device storage
blocks.body: Guest saves, HUD settings, asset choices and the sign-in token are kept in browser local storage and can be cleared in Settings or the browser.

blocks.title: Third parties
blocks.body: Account and cloud data are processed by Supabase and the sign-in provider you choose (Google, GitHub, Discord or Base44) under their own policies.

blocks.title: Security
blocks.body: Access is limited per account: you can only read your own data, and messages can only be read by the sender and recipient. No system is perfectly secure, so do not put secrets in game messages.

blocks.title: Your rights and deletion
blocks.body: Data is kept while your account is active. Deleting the account removes your profile, saves, score, friends and related messages. To request deletion or a copy of your data, use the contact below.

blocks.title: Children
blocks.body: The game is intended for ages 13 and up. Players under 17 should use account and messaging features with a parent or guardian.
